# marker coords test, 0-based
marks={
'6':[(2,9),(4,4),(4,9),(6,6)],
'1':[(9,1),(12,1)],
'4':[(9,9),(11,11),(12,11),(13,9)],
'3':[(16,8),(16,11),(17,6),(19,11)],
'5':[(16,15),(18,15)],
}
from collections import Counter
for a,sa in marks.items():
 for b,sb in marks.items():
  if a>=b: continue
  cnt=Counter((x[0]-y[0],x[1]-y[1]) for x in sa for y in sb) # shift applied b to align its mark y to a mark x
  maxn=max(cnt.values())
  print(a,b,maxn,[(shift,n) for shift,n in cnt.items() if n==maxn])
